text:
Jordan Lee: heads-up — noticed handoff latency spikes specifically for SF connector during EMEA morning (03:00-05:00 UTC). a lot of records linger in enrichment state.
Talia Gomez: that window lines up with our nightly SF sync. are enrichments queued behind the bulk import?
Devon Price: yes, the importer hits the same enrichment worker pool. we should measure per-connector queue depth and enrichment TTL.
Eli Wong: propose we emit a tiny probe event at three points: received (connector), enrich_started, enrich_done (or enrich_failed). keep payload non-PII (hashed id + connector + tenant). sample 10% for first pass.
Jordan Lee: agreed. include `fallback_triggered` + `fallback_type` (default_owner|manual_claim|defer) and `priority_lane` (normal|vip).
Talia Gomez: also capture `enrich_attempts` and `enrich_error_code` where applicable. helps triage flaky third-party enrichors.
Devon Price: good call. basic sketch below:
```
{"lead_h":"sha256:abcd","connector":"salesforce","tenant_region":"emea","recv_ts":1739123400,"enrich_start":1739123410,"enrich_done":1739123500,"enrich_attempts":2,"fallback_triggered":true,"fallback_type":"default_owner","priority_lane":"normal"}
```
Eli Wong: small ops note: make sure `lead_h` is salted per-tenant before hashing so we can't cross-tenant correlate.
Jordan Lee: compliance ok w/ that as long as no raw email/phone. Talia, can you add consent flag if present? e.g., `consent: true|false|null`.
Talia Gomez: yep. I'll add `consent` and `connector_batch_id` for import correlation.
Devon Price: where do we pump these events? Kafka topic `inbound.handoff.probes`? processor will emit Prometheus metrics and a condensed daily summary to our Console.
Eli Wong: yes — plan: probe -> kafka -> enrichment-monitor (consumer) -> metrics + archival S3 (30d) but only hashed ids.
Jordan Lee: alerting: page if p95 end-to-end (recv_ts -> enrich_done/assign) > 240s for >10% of sampled events over 5m.
Talia Gomez: add separate page for `fallback_rate` if default_owner fallbacks > 2% sustained over 10m. that tracks major outages.
Devon Price: also track `rr_fairness_drift` by sampling owner distribution on assigned events. if a single host gets >3x expected share, flag for replay.
Eli Wong: operational constraints: sampling should auto-disable for tenants with less than X leads/min to avoid noise. and include opt-out via `metadata.probe=false`.
Jordan Lee: rollout plan: 1) internal test tenant -> full sampling for 24h; 2) 10% on prod for 48h; 3) 50% for 3 days; then aggregate-only.
Talia Gomez: can we do a quick dashboard view splitting HubSpot vs SF connectors and daylight windows? Product needs to see regional differences.
Devon Price: I'll wire a Grafana panel + Console card. include histogram for `enrich_latency` and heatmap by `connector_batch_id`.
Eli Wong: dev tasks: consumer + schema + unit tests for hashing salt. infra: kafka topic + retention policy (7d raw). analytics: rollup job to compute daily fallback_rate per-tenant.
Jordan Lee: who's owner for the infra ticket?
Devon Price: I'll own the consumer PR. Eli can handle infra topic + alerts. Talia will add MKT-xxxx that includes dashboard and the customer-facing note.
Talia Gomez: creating ticket: MKT-4592 "Connector-specific handoff probes + SF vs HS split dashboard". assigning @Devon, @Eli.
Jordan Lee: communication plan for sales/CS: short note explaining we now have per-connector SLO observability and fallback telemetry. helps with SLA questions.
Devon Price: FYI — one mitigation in-flight: increase enrichment worker concurrency during SF bulk windows. will test in staging today.
SFConnectorBot: bulk import job 555 completed with 12k records at 1739123600 (duration 00:12:34)
Eli Wong: good to know. that batch size may be the culprit. add batch size -> enrich backlog correlation to dashboard.
Talia Gomez: thanks all. next sync after staging run, please drop status in this thread. I'll loop in CS for the customer-facing blurb. :v:
